title: Finding the moment a stream changes

bocpd/change-probability.description: p(a segment starts at this step)

bocpd/map-probability.description: the probability of the most probable run length

bocpd/log-evidence.description: log p(y_1..y_t), the evidence so far

bocpd/predictive-std.description: the standard deviation of y_t given y_1..y_{t-1}

bocpd/run-length.description: p(r_t = r | y_1..y_t) for r = 0, 1, ..., t + 1 (entry 0 is 0)
